name: Chibi Kagura no Bouken
source:
Fandisc is dedicated to Kagura who has the leading role as chibi character in yonkoma episodic story featuring over 50 CG images.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
